concept.title: What Are Cookies
concept.shortdesc: Google uses cookies for functionality, security, advertising, advertising, and personalization.

section.context: NC State uses a variety of Google products on campus, including every student’s official NC State email address. Google collects and uses cookies when you use their products in several different ways.
section.p: Functionality: Deliver and maintain Google services

ul.li: Storing information relating to your session (e.g. the items in your shopping cart)
Enabling features or performing tasks you requested
Product optimizations that help maintain and improve that service

section.p: Security: Protect you as you interact with a service

ul.li: Protecting against spam, fraud, and abuse

section.p: Analytics: Understand how you interact with a particliar service.

ul.li: Measure audience engagement and site statistics

section.p: Advertising: Serve, render, and personalize ads

ul.li: Limit the number of times an ad is shown to a user
Muting ads you have chosen to stop seeing
Delivering and measuring the effectiveness of ads
Providing personalized content and features according to user settings

section.p: Note: Even if you reject cookies and similar technologies used for personalization, you may continue to see personalized ads using other identifiers unless you turn off personalized ads. In addition, the non-personalized content and features you see may still be influenced by contextual factors, like your location, language, device type, or the content you’re currently viewing.
